messages.subject: p value of RMSEA
parts:
In my SEM analysis, i'm getting "NA" for the p-value of RMSEA (0.000). How do i interpret this ?  Any modification required to the model?

messages.author: 12fdd832cacb825e
messages.subject: Re: p value of RMSEA
parts: I would guess you have a saturated model, so all fit indices are perfect with no uncertainty in them. Do you have non-zero degrees of freedom?
